summary: The Greater Cannabis Company filed an 8-K on July 29, 2026, announcing the appointment of three new directors and officers effective upon a 10-day Schedule 14F-1 mailing period. Carlos Septiñ becomes COO, Michelle Cervantes Vivanco CFO, and Ernesto Gómez Berjín Chief Growth Officer. The appointments are linked to the acquisition of control by Trafalgar Asset Management, LLC and ongoing strategic business combination initiatives, though no deal terms were disclosed. CEO Porfirio Sanchez Talavera remains. This is a board-level change related to a control event, not a standalone transactional special situation; watch for further business combination announcements.
